```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var form = document.getElementById('cs-reg-form');
  var errorBox = document.getElementById('cs-error');
  var success = document.getElementById('cs-success');
  var button = document.getElementById('cs-submit');

  function showError(msg) { errorBox.textContent = msg; errorBox.classList.add('is-visible'); }
  function clearError() { errorBox.textContent = ''; errorBox.classList.remove('is-visible'); }

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearError();

    var email = form.email.value.trim();
    var role = form.role.value ? form.role : null;
    var sessions = Array.prototype.map.call(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="session"]:checked'), function (el) { return el.value; });
    var consent = form.consent.checked;

    if (sessions.length === 0) { showError('Please tick at least one session.'); return; }
    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { showError('Please enter a valid email address.'); form.email.focus(); return; }
    if (!role) { showError('Please choose the option that best describes your work.'); form.role.focus(); return; }
    if (!consent) { showError('Please tick the box to agree to how we use your details.'); return; }

    var payload = {
      access_key: form.access_key.value,
      subject: 'ClimateSense session registration: ' + email,
      from_name: form.from_name.value,
      email: email,
      role: role.value,
      sessions: sessions.join('; '),
      consent: 'yes',
      botcheck: form.botcheck.checked ? 'on' : ''
    };

    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Sending…';

    fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (data) { return { ok: r.ok, data: data }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res.ok && res.data && res.data.success) {
          // show only the thank-you message: hide the rest of the page content
          var main = document.querySelector('main');
          var wrap = document.createElement('div');
          wrap.className = 'cs-reg';
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(main.children, function (el) {
            if (el.id !== 'title-block-header') { el.style.display = 'none'; }
          });
          wrap.appendChild(success);
          main.appendChild(wrap);
          success.classList.add('is-visible');
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        } else {
          throw new Error((res.data && res.data.message) || 'Submission failed');
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        showError('Something went wrong and your registration was not sent. Please try again, or email monika.maciuliene@ktu.lt with your preferred session.');
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = 'Register';
      });
  });
})();
</script>
```

## What happens in a session

1. We show you one of our tools with a real example: the database of fact-checks, the map of where claims appear, or the database of who lobbies against climate policy ([LACK](https://climatesense-project.eu/lack/)).
2. We ask how you deal with climate claims: where they come from, what you check and where you get stuck.
3. You tell us what would help you and what the tools are missing. We use this to improve them.

## About ClimateSense

ClimateSense (Climate Misinformation Surveillance and Analysis with Multidimensional GIS) is a research project designed to combat climate-related misinformation through Geographic Information Systems (GIS). Climate misinformation remains widespread. It affects public perception and obstructs effective climate policymaking.

The project builds a multidimensional GIS that integrates climate metrics (temperature, precipitation, wind, carbon emissions) with misinformation data from fact-checkers and media platforms. It lets users explore where climate misinformation emerges, how it spreads and how it relates to observed climate and policy conditions. This enables more targeted monitoring, better prioritisation for fact-checkers and clearer evidence for policy actors. The system will be evaluated using data from the next three COP conferences.

**Period of project implementation:** 2025-03-01 - 2028-02-29

**Project coordinator:** [The Open University](https://www.open.ac.uk/)

**Project partners:** [Kaunas University of Technology](https://en.ktu.edu/), [EURECOM](https://www.eurecom.fr/en/), [Prague University of Economics and Business](https://www.vse.cz/english/)

**Project funding:** [European Coordinated Research on Long-Term Challenges in Information and Communication Sciences and Technologies](https://www.chistera.eu/funded-projects) (CHIST-ERA)
